headlines.title: 报道：美国考虑设立类似FINRA的监管机构，来审查顶尖AI模型
headlines.summary: 在硅谷领袖抱怨美国近期为放缓尖端AI系统发布而采取的措施过于随意后，特朗普政府正在考虑一项计划，拟在业界的参与下，设立一个独立监管机构来审查人工智能模型的安全性。据知情人士透露，财政部长斯科特·贝森特协助制定了该提案。该提案将创建一个向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）汇报的独立AI监管机构，其模式类似于金融业监管局（FINRA）。该计划目前正由白宫幕僚长Susie Wiles进行审查。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: Report: US Considering FINRA-like Regulator to Review Top AI Models
headlines.summary_en: Following complaints from Silicon Valley leaders that US efforts to slow the release of advanced AI systems have been too arbitrary, the Trump administration is considering a plan to create an independent regulatory agency, with industry input, to review AI model safety. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has helped draft the proposal, which would establish an independent AI regulator reporting to the SEC, modeled on FINRA. The plan is currently under review by White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles. (Bloomberg).

headlines.title: 昨日多只宽基ETF显著放量，高盛称中国股市“国家队”ETF录得15个月最大四日资金流入

headlines.title_en: Broad-based ETFs Saw Significant Volume Surge; Goldman Sachs Says China 'National Team' ETFs Recorded Largest Four-Day Inflow in 15 Months
headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs' 'National Team' ETF flow tracker shows net inflows of RMB 29 billion from July 13-16, the largest four-session cumulative total since April 2025. Additionally, broad-based ETFs saw continued high volume on July 17. At close, the Yi Fund ChiNext ETF, Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF, and ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF all posted daily turnover exceeding RMB 10 billion, at RMB 15.427 billion, RMB 14.649 billion, and RMB 14.287 billion respectively.

headlines.summary: “引导高质量的应用，促进消费升级，要探索跨行业、跨领域的合作，促进人工智能终端在智能制造、智慧教育、文旅、视听等领域的垂类示范作用。依托智能化分级等标准体系，加大对优质人工智能终端产品消费的补贴，引导、鼓励消费者采购人工智能终端优品、名品，提高公众的认知度和接受度。”7月17日，2026世界人工智能大会（WAIC2026）开幕，在“人工智能终端产业演进与协同发展”论坛上，全国政协委员、工业和信息化部原副部长王江平围绕“人工智能终端”提出上述建议，他认为，当前正是人工智能终端发展浪潮的一个关键的窗口期，业界人士应该要抓住机遇。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: Former Vice Minister of MIIT Wang Jiangping Suggests Increasing Subsidies for Premium AI Consumer Terminals
headlines.summary_en: 'To guide high-quality applications and promote consumption upgrades, we should explore cross-industry and cross-sector cooperation, promoting the vertical demonstration role of AI terminals in areas such as intelligent manufacturing, smart education, cultural tourism, and audiovisual. Leveraging standard systems like intelligence grading, we should increase subsidies for high-quality AI terminal product consumption, guiding and encouraging consumers to purchase excellent and renowned AI terminal products, raising public awareness and acceptance.' On July 17, at the opening of the 2026 World AI Conference (WAIC 2026), Wang Jiangping, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and former Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, made the above suggestion at the 'AI Terminal Industry Evolution and Collaborative Development' forum. He believes the current period is a critical window for the wave of AI terminal development, and industry players should seize the opportunity. (The Paper)

headlines.title: China’s second-quarter GDP growth misses mark, with lowest reading since end of 2022
headlines.summary:
China reported 4.3 per cent gross domestic product growth in the second quarter of 2026 shortly after recording strong, sustained momentum in exports – a contrast underscoring the need for policy support to address weak domestic demand and persistent economic imbalances.
The closely watched GDP figure, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday, was the slowest quarterly growth rate since the end of 2022. The number fell below the 4.48 per cent forecast from economists...

headlines.title: 四大行提示“存100万元解锁5.25%利息”不实
headlines.summary: 中国工商银行、中国农业银行、中国银行、中国建设银行发布风险提示，提醒金融消费者警惕“存100万元解锁5.25%利息”“固定年化收益5%”等虚假信息。四家银行表示，近期，有不法分子利用第三方互联网平台及社交媒体等渠道，冒用国有商业银行名义，发布“存100万元解锁5.25%利息”“固定年化收益5%”等虚假高息收益广告，并且以此诱导消费者添加微信等联系方式，进而推介境外保险产品或者投资境外平台项目等，牟取高额佣金甚至实施诈骗。经核实，当前不存在此类存款产品，相关宣传均为虚假信息。（广州日报）

headlines.title: 全国首张脑机接口处方开出并成功手术
headlines.summary: 日前，植入式脑机接口手部运动功能代偿系统获批上市后的首张处方在上海开出，全球首例植入手术完成。从获批上市到进入真实诊疗，一项曾仅限于实验室的前沿技术，成为了符合条件的患者可评估使用的医疗器械。从3月13日斩获全球“首证”，到7月13日开出全球“首方”，该国产脑机接口设备仅用四个月就实现从创新研发到落地诊疗的跨越。上海相关部门全程加速审批指导、研审联动，医院同步完成价格备案、设备入院、患者筛选等系列工作。目前，该脑机接口系统已纳入上海“沪惠保”保障范畴。医保、卫健部门同步跟进临床应用，完善支付政策、细化操作规范，拓展应用场景。

headlines.summary: “引导高质量的应用，促进消费升级，要探索跨行业、跨领域的合作，促进人工智能终端在智能制造、智慧教育、文旅、视听等领域的垂类示范作用。依托智能化分级等标准体系，加大对优质人工智能终端产品消费的补贴，引导、鼓励消费者采购人工智能终端优品、名品，提高公众的认知度和接受度。”7月17日，2026世界人工智能大会（WAIC2026）开幕，在“人工智能终端产业演进与协同发展”论坛上，全国政协委员、工业和信息化部原副部长王江平围绕“人工智能终端”提出上述建议，他认为，当前正是人工智能终端发展浪潮的一个关键的窗口期，业界人士应该要抓住机遇。（澎湃）
